raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
- [x] I, the PR author, have personally reviewed every line of this PR.

## What does this PR do?

Honor independent MFSDP v2 sharding policies for dense and expert parameters. DeepSeek V3 MLPerf uses dense inner ZeRO-2, expert inner ZeRO-3, and outer ZeRO-1 for both. At 256 GPUs, EP64, and four optimizer instances, the dense mesh is `(4,64)` and the expert mesh is `(4,1)`.

Remove the adapter's dense ZeRO-3 restriction and build expert-specific placements for MoE models even at EP=1. Dense tests compare losses against a ZeRO-3 reference spanning all DP ranks, including gradient accumulation. MoE tests check placements and finite losses across repeated optimizer steps with independent dense/expert outer policies at EP=1/2. CUDA-graph tests cover full training and optimizer replay for hybrid ZeRO-2.

The DBuffer support from #7633 and CUDA-graph profiler fix (#7726) are now merged in `main`. This PR is independent of the quantized-wrapper change (#7727). Companion Bridge fix: https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/pull/6200.

## Validation

- Rebased onto `main` at `3bb482c487cd447a2b40a3bf076ab14cad514e13`, preserving the current training-loop helpers. The adapter suite passed on two RTX A6000 GPU ranks: **29 passed, 4 skipped, 1 Blackwell-only case deselected per rank**. The skipped MoE hybrid cases require four ranks for EP=2.
- Repository formatting/lint check completed successfully; Black, isort, and Ruff passed, and Pylint rated the code 10/10 with its unsupported `bad-builtins` configuration diagnostic. Advisory mypy reported three missing Transformer Engine type-metadata errors. `git diff --check` passed.

- Rebased onto `1b3e04143` after #7633 merged. `git range-diff` confirms all feature patches are unchanged; syntax and whitespace checks passed. GPU tests were not rerun for this rebase.
- Rebased onto `bab851bfe`. EOS job 6129095 passed 28 adapter cases, including dense hybrid and CUDA-graph coverage, before encountering a stale MoE placement assertion after #7670. Updated the internal DBuffer expectation to `RowAtomic()`; public DTensor expectations remain `Shard(0)`.
- EOS job 6129175 passed all eight MoE placement cases on all eight H100 ranks (EP=1/2 and independent dense/expert outer policies). Together, these runs cover every retained adapter case; one MXFP8 case requires Blackwell and was skipped. No fixture or profiler overlays were applied.
- Black, isort, Ruff, and `git diff --check` passed. Repository checks retain the existing Pylint configuration error and missing Transformer Engine typing diagnostics.

Full 671B/256-GPU training and performance benchmarking are not covered.

## Contribution process

- [x] Updated relevant adapter tests.
- [x] Ran the repository autoformatter in check mode (limitations above).
